plugin.name: Kubernetes
plugin.description: Manage Kubernetes clusters from your hosts over SSH, with logs, metrics, YAML and a shell.

use.title: Use Kubernetes
use.description: Open the Kubernetes view and pod shells on hosts with Kubernetes turned on.

secrets.title: Reveal Kubernetes secrets
secrets.description: Show the decoded values of Kubernetes secrets. Every reveal is written to the audit log.

enable.label: Enable Kubernetes
enable.description: Run kubectl on this host over SSH to manage the cluster it can reach.

kubectlFlavor.label: Kubernetes flavor
kubectlFlavor.description: Which command runs kubectl on this host.

kubeconfig.label: Kubeconfig path
kubeconfig.description: Leave empty to use the default for the SSH user (~/.kube/config or KUBECONFIG).

context.label: Default context
context.description: Leave empty to use the current context in the kubeconfig. You can switch contexts in the Kubernetes tab.

namespace.label: Default namespace
namespace.description: The namespace the Kubernetes tab opens with.

useSudo.label: Run with sudo
useSudo.description: Run kubectl with sudo -n, for k3s and MicroK8s setups where only root can read the cluster config. The SSH user needs passwordless sudo.

readOnly.label: Read only
readOnly.description: Only look. Blocks scaling, restarts, deletes, YAML changes, Helm changes and pod shells for everyone on this host.

showPanel.label: Show Kubernetes panel in terminals
showPanel.description: Allow the Kubernetes panel to open beside SSH terminals on this host.

companionAutoOpen.label: Open the Kubernetes panel with new terminals
companionAutoOpen.description: Show the Kubernetes panel beside every SSH terminal that has Kubernetes on. You can still open and close it from the button on the right edge.

companionSide.label: Kubernetes panel side
companionSide.description: Where the Kubernetes panel sits next to a terminal.

companionSize.label: Kubernetes panel size
companionSize.description: Width in pixels, or height when it is at the bottom. You can also drag its edge.

companionEdgeButton.label: Show the panel button
companionEdgeButton.description: Show a small button on the right edge of a terminal that opens the Kubernetes panel.

kube.notEnabled: Kubernetes is not enabled for this host
kube.notEnabledHint: Turn on Kubernetes in this host's settings to manage its cluster.

restart.label: Restart
restart.confirmText: Every pod of this {{kind}} is replaced one by one.

setImage.label: Change image
setImage.title: Change the image of {{name}}
setImage.hint: The pods are replaced with the new image.

suspend.label: Suspend
suspend.confirmText: This {{kind}} stops starting new runs until you resume it.

cordon.label: Cordon
cordon.confirmText: No new pods are scheduled on this {{kind}}. Pods already on it keep running.

drain.label: Drain
drain.title: Drain {{name}}
drain.text: Cordons {{name}} and evicts its pods so they move to other nodes. DaemonSet pods stay.
drain.emptyDirHint: Evict pods that keep data in emptyDir volumes. That data is lost.
drain.forceHint: Also evict pods no controller manages. They are not recreated.

delete.label: Delete
delete.confirmText: This {{kind}} is removed from the cluster.
delete.managedPodText: This pod belongs to a controller, which starts a new one in its place.
delete.namespaceText: Everything inside this namespace is deleted too. This cannot be undone.

history.confirmText: {{name}} goes back to the pod template of that revision.

data.secretHint: Values stay hidden until you reveal them. Revealing is written to the audit log.
data.secretNoPermission: You can see the keys but not the values. Ask an admin for the Reveal Kubernetes secrets permission.

metrics.unavailableHint: Install metrics-server in the cluster to see CPU and memory use.
metrics.startPod: Start the pod to see its stats.

apply.title: Apply YAML
apply.hint: Paste one or more manifests. Check runs a dry run on the server and Diff shows what changes. Nothing changes until you apply.

helm.allValuesHint: Show every value, not only the ones set at install.
helm.rollbackText: Helm makes a new revision with the old one's settings.
helm.uninstallText: Helm deletes every resource of this release.

console.clickToConnect: Pick a shell and click Connect
console.failedToConnect: Failed to connect to the pod
console.podNotRunningHint: Start the pod to open a shell in it.
console.readOnlyHint: This host is read only, so pod shells are turned off.

terminal.clipboardReadFailed: Failed to read from clipboard. Make sure clipboard permissions are granted.
terminal.clipboardWriteFailed: Failed to copy to clipboard. Make sure the page is served over HTTPS or localhost.

errors.remoteServerRequired: Remote server required. Connect a remote server in Settings to use this connection type.

card.title: Kubernetes clusters
card.empty: No hosts have Kubernetes turned on.
